title: Doses of insulins
symptom: User wants to know how to enter doses of fast and slow insulins in xDrip+ because when clicking on the syringe icon there is no distinction between the two types; only one kind of insulin can be entered.
cause: The thread indicates that there was no distinction between basal and bolus insulin entries in the original version, and many users had requested this feature but it had not been added.
fix: The capability to use multiple insulin types exists. Navigate to Settings -> xDrip+ Predictive Simulation -> Multiple Insulin Types.
evidence_quote: The capability to use multiple insulin types exists. Please see Settings -> xDrip+ Predictive Simulation -> Multiple Insulin Types
